name: OpenText Content Server
description: Connect your own OpenText Content Server (OTCS) instance to browse and manage Nodes (folders/documents), Versions, Permissions, Members, Categories (metadata), and run a content-health audit.

tools.name: connect_content_server
tools.description: Connect your own OpenText Content Server instance with its base URL, username, and password.

label.description: Friendly instance label, e.g. 'Acme Content Server'.
label.title: Label

username.description: Content Server username with REST API access.
username.title: Username

password.description: Content Server password for that username.
password.title: Password

tools.name: disconnect_content_server
tools.description: Disconnect a saved Content Server instance and delete its stored credentials.

connection_id.description: Saved Content Server connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected OpenText Content Server instances.

tools.name: audit_content_health
tools.description: Scan a folder tree and flag content-health issues: empty documents, nodes with no categories, and very large files.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Node ID to audit. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List metadata categories (templates) attached to a node.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Content Server node ID. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

tools.name: get_category_values
tools.description: Read a metadata category's current attribute values on a node.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Content Server node ID. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

tools.name: set_category_values
tools.description: Set metadata category attribute values on a node.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Content Server node ID. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

values_json.description: JSON object of attribute-name to value pairs matching the category's schema, e.g. '{"Status": "Approved"}'.
values_json.title: Values Json

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Read one Content Server node's (folder or document) metadata in full.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Content Server node ID. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

tools.name: list_node_children
tools.description: List files and subfolders directly inside a Content Server node (folder).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Content Server node ID. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder inside a parent node.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

parent_id.description: Parent node ID to create the folder inside. Use '2000' for root.
parent_id.title: Parent Id

tools.name: rename_or_move_node
tools.description: Rename a node and/or move it to a different parent folder.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Content Server node ID. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

name.description: New node name. Leave blank to keep the current name.
name.title: Name

new_parent_id.description: Destination parent node ID to move into. Leave blank to keep in place.
new_parent_id.title: New Parent Id

tools.name: delete_node
tools.description: Permanently delete a node (folder or document). Cannot be undone.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Content Server node ID. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

tools.name: download_document
tools.description: Download a document's content, base64-encoded.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Content Server node ID. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

tools.name: upload_document
tools.description: Upload a new document (base64-encoded content) into a folder.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

parent_id.description: Folder node ID to upload into. Use '2000' for root.
parent_id.title: Parent Id

name.description: Document name to save as, e.g. 'contract.pdf'.
name.title: Name

tools.name: upload_document_version
tools.description: Upload a new version of an existing document.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Content Server node ID. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

filename.description: Optional filename for this new version. Leave blank to keep the document's current name.
filename.title: Filename

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Search for nodes (folders and documents) by free-text query.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_permissions
tools.description: List the permission grants (who can see/modify/delete) on a node.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Content Server node ID. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

tools.name: grant_permission
tools.description: Grant a user or group a set of permissions on a node.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Content Server node ID. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

member_id.description: User or group ID to grant access to, from list_members.
member_id.title: Member Id

tools.name: revoke_permission
tools.description: Revoke a member's custom permissions on a node.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Content Server node ID. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

member_id.description: User or group ID to revoke access from.
member_id.title: Member Id

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List users and groups (members) on the connected Content Server instance, optionally filtered by name.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List the saved versions of a document.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Content Server node ID. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

tools.name: promote_version
tools.description: Promote a previous document version to be the current version.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Content Server node ID. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

version_number.description: Version number to promote to current, from list_versions.
version_number.title: Version Number

tools.name: delete_version
tools.description: Permanently delete a document version. Cannot be undone.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Content Server connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

node_id.description: Content Server node ID. Use '2000' for the Enterprise Workspace root.
node_id.title: Node Id

version_number.description: Version number to delete, from list_versions.
version_number.title: Version Number

secrets.name: content_server_connections
secrets.description: JSON list of connected Content Server instances and their username/password (needed to silently re-authenticate expired session tickets). Managed only through connect_content_server and disconnect_content_server.
